label: App Shell
description: The frame an app lives inside: a sidebar (app name slot + data-driven nav items with active-route highlighting), a top bar (page title, actions slot, user area placeholder), and a content outlet where your Page Router goes. Nav items are a plain array (Label/Icon/Target) fed from a Static Data node or the Nav Items input; clicking one navigates to its Target and emits Nav Click/Nav Target. Below the Collapse Below breakpoint (default 768px) the sidebar collapses behind a hamburger button.
